# llegir

**llegir** is a package for LLM-enabled gene-program interpretations in
R. In transcriptomics data analysis, we often work with groups of genes
that are somehow related to one another, and **llegir** aims to automate
the interpretation of these interrelated groups of genes, which we refer
to as “*gene modules*”. **llegir** is completely agnostic to the
sequencing technology (e.g. bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq,
sequencing or imaging based spatial transcriptomics, etc), and it is
agnostic to the method used to group genes into modules (e.g. WGCNA,
matrix factorization, literature-derived gene lists, etc).

**llegir** takes as input a gene expression matrix and a set of *gene
modules*, for instance coming from our other tool
![hdWGCNA](https://smorabit.github.io/hdWGCNA/). Next, **llegir**
compiles a set of “evidence” for each module by running a user-defined
chain of analysis tools, flexibly defined to suit the specific needs of
each dataset. The results of these analysis tools are then assembled
into an “evidence packet” that is given to an LLM of the user’s choice
for synthesis, summarization, and interpretation. Finally, **llegir**
compiles an .html report for the interpretation of all modules. A
completed run can also be exported as a read-only [agent
workspace](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/docs/agent_workspace.md)
for an external terminal coding agent to interrogate directly.

**llegir** means “to read” in the Catalan language.

## Development stage

**llegir** is in an experimental development stage, and at this point it
is subject to major changes until we have pushed a more stable release,
proceed with caution!

## Installation

``` r

remotes::install_github("smorabit/llegir")
```

See the [Getting
Started](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/vignettes/getting-started.Rmd)
vignette for a full quick start walkthrough.

# Package index

## ModuleSet adapter

The backend-agnostic contract every core tool depends on –
capabilities() plus hdWGCNA/Seurat, tidy-components, and gene-list
adapters – and the self-contained synthetic fixture used in examples and
the vignette.

- [`modules()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/modules.md)
  : List the module ids in a module set
- [`gene_membership()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/gene_membership.md)
  : Genes assigned to a module, ranked by membership strength
- [`module_scores()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/module_scores.md)
  : Per-cell (or per-sample) module scores
- [`expression()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/expression.md)
  : Underlying expression matrix backing a module set
- [`metadata()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/metadata.md)
  : Cell / sample metadata for a module set
- [`pkg_versions()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/pkg_versions.md)
  : Backend package versions for provenance logging
- [`capabilities()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/capabilities.md)
  : Which capabilities a ModuleSet provides
- [`has_capability()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/has_capability.md)
  : Check whether a ModuleSet has a given capability
- [`hdWGCNA_ModuleSet()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/hdWGCNA_ModuleSet.md)
  [`modules(`*`<hdWGCNA_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/hdWGCNA_ModuleSet.md)
  [`gene_membership(`*`<hdWGCNA_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/hdWGCNA_ModuleSet.md)
  [`module_scores(`*`<hdWGCNA_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/hdWGCNA_ModuleSet.md)
  [`expression(`*`<hdWGCNA_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/hdWGCNA_ModuleSet.md)
  [`counts(`*`<hdWGCNA_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/hdWGCNA_ModuleSet.md)
  [`metadata(`*`<hdWGCNA_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/hdWGCNA_ModuleSet.md)
  [`pkg_versions(`*`<hdWGCNA_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/hdWGCNA_ModuleSet.md)
  [`capabilities(`*`<hdWGCNA_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/hdWGCNA_ModuleSet.md)
  : Build a ModuleSet from a Seurat object with an hdWGCNA experiment
- [`components_ModuleSet()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/components_ModuleSet.md)
  [`modules(`*`<components_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/components_ModuleSet.md)
  [`gene_membership(`*`<components_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/components_ModuleSet.md)
  [`module_scores(`*`<components_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/components_ModuleSet.md)
  [`expression(`*`<components_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/components_ModuleSet.md)
  [`counts(`*`<components_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/components_ModuleSet.md)
  [`metadata(`*`<components_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/components_ModuleSet.md)
  [`pkg_versions(`*`<components_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/components_ModuleSet.md)
  [`capabilities(`*`<components_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/components_ModuleSet.md)
  : Build a ModuleSet from tidy components
- [`gene_list_ModuleSet()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/gene_list_ModuleSet.md)
  [`pkg_versions(`*`<gene_list_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/gene_list_ModuleSet.md)
  : Build a ModuleSet from named gene lists, scoring on the fly
- [`pseudobulk_ModuleSet()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/pseudobulk_ModuleSet.md)
  [`pkg_versions(`*`<pseudobulk_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/pseudobulk_ModuleSet.md)
  : Build a ModuleSet from pseudo-bulk counts, re-scoring modules with
  decoupleR
- [`synthetic_ModuleSet()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/synthetic_ModuleSet.md)
  [`modules(`*`<synthetic_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/synthetic_ModuleSet.md)
  [`module_scores(`*`<synthetic_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/synthetic_ModuleSet.md)
  [`gene_membership(`*`<synthetic_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/synthetic_ModuleSet.md)
  [`expression(`*`<synthetic_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/synthetic_ModuleSet.md)
  [`counts(`*`<synthetic_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/synthetic_ModuleSet.md)
  [`metadata(`*`<synthetic_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/synthetic_ModuleSet.md)
  [`pkg_versions(`*`<synthetic_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/synthetic_ModuleSet.md)
  [`capabilities(`*`<synthetic_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/synthetic_ModuleSet.md)
  : Wrap a ModuleSet with hand-picked gene sets as synthetic modules
- [`llegir_example_moduleset()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/llegir_example_moduleset.md)
  : A small, self-contained synthetic ModuleSet for examples and the
  vignette
- [`counts()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/counts.md) :
  Underlying raw counts matrix backing a module set
- [`validate_moduleset()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/validate_moduleset.md)
  : Validate that a ModuleSet satisfies the full adapter contract
- [`with_pseudobulk()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/with_pseudobulk.md)
  [`capabilities(`*`<with_pseudobulk_ModuleSet>`*`)`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/with_pseudobulk.md)
  : Attach a pseudo-bulk ModuleSet view to a cell-level ModuleSet
- [`pseudobulk()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/pseudobulk.md)
  : Attached pseudo-bulk view for a ModuleSet
- [`pseudobulk_view()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/pseudobulk_view.md)
  : Resolve the pseudo-bulk view for a ModuleSet

## Evidence tools

Core deterministic evidence tools; each returns one evidence_fragment.

- [`top_genes_tool()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/top_genes_tool.md)
  : Evidence tool: top module genes ranked by membership (kME)

- [`cluster_dme_tool()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/cluster_dme_tool.md)
  : Evidence tool: which cell states express this module

- [`geneset_enrichment_tool()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/geneset_enrichment_tool.md)
  : Evidence tool: gene-set enrichment among a module's hub genes

- [`signature_correlation_tool()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/signature_correlation_tool.md)
  : Evidence tool: correlate module activity with a signature library

- [`differential_module_activity_tool()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/differential_module_activity_tool.md)
  : Evidence tool: does a module's pseudo-bulk activity differ across a
  condition

- [`pseudobulk_de_limma_tool()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/pseudobulk_de_limma_tool.md)
  : Evidence tool: gene-level pseudo-bulk differential expression
  (limma-voom)

- [`import_fragment()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/import_fragment.md)
  : Import a user-supplied result table as an evidence fragment

- [`import_fragment_tool()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/import_fragment_tool.md)
  :

  `ctx`-compatible tool wrapper around
  [`import_fragment()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/import_fragment.md)

- [`import_seurat_markers()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/import_seurat_markers.md)
  : Import a Seurat / DESeq2 / edgeR differential-expression table

- [`import_hdwgcna_dme()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/import_hdwgcna_dme.md)
  : Import an hdWGCNA differential module eigengene (DME) table

- [`import_enrichr()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/import_enrichr.md)
  : Import an EnrichR / GeneOverlap enrichment table

## Dataset tools

Global, once-per-dataset tools; each returns one dataset_fragment,
bundled into a dataset_context via run_dataset_context() and injected as
shared framing into every module’s synthesis prompt.

- [`dataset_composition_tool()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/dataset_composition_tool.md)
  : Dataset tool: cell-state census and condition covariate balance
- [`dataset_variance_structure_tool()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/dataset_variance_structure_tool.md)
  : Dataset tool: how much dataset variance aligns with each metadata
  covariate
- [`dataset_baseline_expression_tool()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/dataset_baseline_expression_tool.md)
  : Dataset tool: dataset-wide baseline expression and housekeeping
  signal

## Tool registry

register_tool() makes tool registration a uniform, documented public API
for core and custom tools alike; see docs/custom_tools.md.

- [`register_tool()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/register_tool.md)
  : Register a tool (core or custom) in the tool registry
- [`get_tool()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/get_tool.md)
  : Look up a registered tool spec by id
- [`list_tools()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/list_tools.md)
  : List every registered tool id

## Evidence fragments and packets

The evidence_fragment / evidence packet data contract.

- [`evidence_fragment()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/evidence_fragment.md)
  : Construct an evidence fragment
- [`validate_evidence_fragment()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/validate_evidence_fragment.md)
  : Validate an evidence fragment
- [`fragment_to_json()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/fragment_to_json.md)
  : Serialize an evidence fragment to JSON
- [`fragment_from_json()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/fragment_from_json.md)
  : Parse an evidence fragment from JSON
- [`build_evidence_packet()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/build_evidence_packet.md)
  : Assemble and hash a module's evidence packet
- [`packet_to_json()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/packet_to_json.md)
  : Serialize an evidence packet to JSON
- [`write_evidence_packet()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/write_evidence_packet.md)
  : Write an evidence packet to a JSON file
- [`read_evidence_packet()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/read_evidence_packet.md)
  : Read an evidence packet from a JSON file
- [`write_fragment_tables()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/write_fragment_tables.md)
  : Write every fragment's full result table alongside a packet
- [`write_fragment_figures()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/write_fragment_figures.md)
  : Materialize every fragment's live plots to PNG files
- [`attach_plots()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/attach_plots.md)
  : Attach plots to an evidence or dataset fragment
- [`make_provenance()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/make_provenance.md)
  : Build a fragment's provenance record

## Dataset fragments and context

The dataset_fragment / dataset_context data contract – the dataset-tool
sibling of an evidence_fragment / evidence packet, scoped to the whole
experiment rather than one module.

- [`dataset_fragment()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/dataset_fragment.md)
  : Construct a dataset fragment

- [`validate_dataset_fragment()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/validate_dataset_fragment.md)
  : Validate a dataset fragment

- [`dataset_fragment_to_json()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/dataset_fragment_to_json.md)
  : Serialize a dataset fragment to JSON

- [`dataset_fragment_from_json()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/dataset_fragment_from_json.md)
  : Parse a dataset fragment from JSON

- [`build_dataset_context()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/build_dataset_context.md)
  : Assemble and hash a dataset context

- [`dataset_context_to_json()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/dataset_context_to_json.md)
  : Serialize a dataset context to JSON

- [`write_dataset_context()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/write_dataset_context.md)
  : Write a dataset context to a JSON file

- [`read_dataset_context()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/read_dataset_context.md)
  : Read a dataset context from a JSON file

- [`render_dataset_context_compact()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/render_dataset_context_compact.md)
  : Render a dataset context as a compact model-facing text block

- [`import_dataset_fragment()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/import_dataset_fragment.md)
  : Import a user-supplied result table as a dataset fragment

- [`import_dataset_fragment_tool()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/import_dataset_fragment_tool.md)
  :

  `ctx`-compatible tool wrapper around
  [`import_dataset_fragment()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/import_dataset_fragment.md)

- [`import_milo_da()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/import_milo_da.md)
  : Import a miloR differential-abundance neighborhood table

## Orchestration

Run tools/synthesis over a module set and write results to disk.

- [`run_module()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/run_module.md)
  : Run one module's evidence tools and build its evidence packet
- [`run_orchestrator()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/run_orchestrator.md)
  : Run a configured set of evidence tools over every module in a
  ModuleSet
- [`run_dataset_context()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/run_dataset_context.md)
  : Build a dataset context once per dataset
- [`synthesize_module()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/synthesize_module.md)
  : Synthesize one evidence packet into a validated interpretation
- [`run_synthesis_orchestrator()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/run_synthesis_orchestrator.md)
  : Run synthesis over a batch of evidence packets

- [`build_user_prompt()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/build_user_prompt.md)
  : Build the synthesis user prompt for one module

## Synthesis backends

Model-agnostic packet -\> interpretation synthesis.

- [`synthesize_interpretation()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/synthesize_interpretation.md)
  : Synthesize one evidence packet into an interpretation via a backend
- [`mock_backend()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/mock_backend.md)
  : Offline mock synthesis backend
- [`ellmer_backend()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/ellmer_backend.md)
  : Live synthesis backend via ellmer structured output
- [`resolve_backend()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/resolve_backend.md)
  : Resolve a synthesis backend from a provider name
- [`cached_backend()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/cached_backend.md)
  : Cache a synthesis backend's raw model calls on disk
- [`llm_server_status()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/llm_server_status.md)
  : Query a local vLLM server's model list
- [`local_backend()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/local_backend.md)
  : Convenience constructor for the local vLLM backend
- [`model_output_schema_json()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/model_output_schema_json.md)
  : Model-facing interpretation schema, derived from the canonical
  schema

## Faithfulness and confidence

Guardrails between the model’s output and the deterministic evidence.

- [`check_faithfulness()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/check_faithfulness.md)
  : Check citation faithfulness of an interpretation against its packet
- [`is_faithful()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/is_faithful.md)
  : Is an interpretation faithful to its evidence packet?
- [`assert_faithfulness()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/assert_faithfulness.md)
  : Hard-reject an interpretation with any faithfulness violation
- [`enforce_faithfulness()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/enforce_faithfulness.md)
  : Flag (rather than reject) an interpretation with faithfulness
  violations
- [`compute_evidence_signals()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/compute_evidence_signals.md)
  : Compute deterministic evidence signals from a packet
- [`calculate_fusion_score()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/calculate_fusion_score.md)
  : Calculate the deterministic fused evidence confidence for a packet
- [`fuse_confidence()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/fuse_confidence.md)
  : Fuse model and deterministic confidence into a final score and flags
- [`needs_review()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/needs_review.md)
  : Does an interpretation need human review?

## Agent workspace

export_agent_workspace() serializes a completed run and renders a static
launchpad file for an external terminal coding agent to run open-ended,
read-only queries against it; see docs/agent_workspace.md.

- [`export_agent_workspace()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/export_agent_workspace.md)
  : Export a self-contained agent workspace and manifest
- [`read_agent_manifest()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/read_agent_manifest.md)
  : Read an agent workspace manifest's front-matter

## Statistical helpers

- [`categorical_group_test()`](https://smorabit.github.io/llegir/reference/categorical_group_test.md)
  : One-vs-rest categorical group test with an omnibus Kruskal-Wallis
  test
